M5 — 2026-10-13
A driven verify can fail after every test passes, at vitest shutdown ('error during close … hermetic run failed: HOME canary'), when a live host session creates a NEW clone key under ~/.local/state/sofar/{folds,diagnostics}/<hash>. To check, read <hash>/quick.jsonl in diagnostics: if its 'session'/'host' rows are a live host session, not a test, just rerun. Don't add a HOST_LIVE entry, because new names under .local/state/sofar are exactly what the canary is meant to catch.
